intended_distribution: Bundled with LocalPinyinIME source and unsigned development packages as the project-maintained local_core dictionary layer.
source_policy: Project-maintained first-party authored lexicon. No third-party bulk lexicon was imported; no Rime, Sogou, Baidu, Microsoft, Google, or public GitHub candidate dictionary data is used. Pypinyin is an authoring-only pronunciation checker with manually reviewed compound overrides; neither Python nor its library is bundled in the input method. Independent prose used for the separate character context model is attributed in authoring/sources.json.
frequency_policy: Frequency values are project-maintained relative ranking weights using coarse bands such as 9000, 7000, 5000, and 3000. They are not internet frequency, search frequency, commercial IME frequency, or external corpus statistics.
review_status: approved for development release after format, duplicate-key, category, and benchmark validation; entries are first-party curated but have not all received formal linguistic review

pronunciation_review.method: All project entries checked against all per-character readings; flagged rows reviewed manually; accepted input aliases retained
pronunciation_review.note: Also corrected 简朴/调班/调课/调色/调色盘/有线耳机 by compound review. This is not a claim of exhaustive linguistic correctness.
